name: AD536A rms-to-DC side-chain, SSL 82E10 style (validation circuit)
description: An AD536AJ wired as the SSL 4000 E dynamics card (82E10) wires it: the side-chain signal through 10 uF and 6.2k into VIN with 10k to 0 V, CAV 3.3 nF to +15 V, -VS on -18 V, RL and COM at 0 V, IOUT open (linear output, 25k), the dB pin (-3 mV/dB) into an inverting amplifier of gain 36.5k / 1.11k (about +100 mV/dB). A second section of the test averages with 1 uF so the linear and dB outputs settle to the rms value; its buffer follows IOUT.
